primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, H3, Section Titles, Dashboard Overviews
primary_heading.anti_pattern: Do not use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Descriptions, general UI text, paragraphs, standard list items

data_codes.usage: Production Item Codes, IDs, pricing data, historical metrics, search shortcuts

layouts.overall_structure: Three-pane Master-Detail setup: Left Nav (fixed w-64) + Main Content Area + Right Detail Panel (sliding drawer or split-pane, w-96 to w-112).
layouts.left_navigation: Organized sequentially: Knowledge Domains -> Production Items -> Assemblies -> Service Categories -> Templates -> Historical Production -> Archives. Use active states with an emerald left-border highlight. Text should be neutral-400 default, white on active. Spacing between sections must be generous (py-2).
layouts.production_grid: NOT a spreadsheet. Use a refined List-Grid hybrid. Rows have generous padding (py-3 px-4), subtle border-b (border-neutral-800), and a responsive hover effect (hover:bg-neutral-900). Use flex layouts within rows for multi-column sortability. Emphasize data codes with monospace.
layouts.detail_panel: Professional engineering record view. Clean visual hierarchy with H3 headings, mono-spaced data points for pricing/standards, visual pill tags for Categories, and a timeline-style UI for Revisions.
layouts.assembly_builder: Indented visual node list (drag-and-drop feel), with connecting lines (border-l-2 border-neutral-800) to show hierarchy between Production Items.

components_and_micro_themes.surfaces: No pure black transparency. Overlays (like Command Palette, Dialogs, Dropdowns, Sticky Headers) MUST use bg-[#0A0A0A]/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-neutral-800. Never fully transparent to ensure readability.
components_and_micro_themes.global_search: Notion-style Command Palette (triggered by `Ctrl/Cmd + K`). Instant search results broken down visually by categories (Domains, Items, Codes). High contrast matching terms (text-emerald-400).
components_and_micro_themes.company_brain: Integrate natural intelligence organically. Do not build a chat window. Instead, inject insights naturally: e.g., a subtle 'sparkle' icon (lucide-react: Sparkles, color: emerald-400) next to auto-suggested categories, pricing anomalies, or a 'Brain Insights' sub-section in the detail panel.
components_and_micro_themes.buttons: Modern, sleek. Primary: bg-emerald-500 text-black font-medium hover:bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.2)]. Secondary: bg-neutral-900 text-white border border-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-800.
components_and_micro_themes.badges: Pill-shaped, text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full. Default: bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800. Active/Insight: bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20.
components_and_micro_themes.icons: Use lucide-react exclusively. Stroke width 1.5 for a clean, sharp, professional look.

motion.hover: Subtle and fast. Use transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.lists: Staggered fade-in for grid rows to make loading feel intentional and premium.
motion.panels: Slide in from right for the Detail Panel (transform translate-x duration-300 ease-out).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-neutral-400 passes APCA/WCAG against #0A0A0A. Use focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/50 for all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded on accordions/dropdowns, aria-hidden on decorative icons (like the Brain sparkle).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: All components must be written in `.jsx` or `.js` format, NOT `.tsx`.

CRITICAL: Every interactive element and key UI region MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="nav-domains-link"`, `data-testid="global-search-input"`, `data-testid="production-item-row"`).
CRITICAL: Headers, Overlays, Command Palettes, and Dropdowns MUST have solid or blurred dark backgrounds (e.g., `bg-neutral-950/90 backdrop-blur-md`). NEVER fully transparent.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. No generic centered layouts, simplistic large gradients, or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders (border-neutral-800).
DO NOT use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform` to prevent visual bugs.
DO NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
NEVER use generic emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Always use Lucide React icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look like cheap spreadsheets. The tool needs to feel like a premium knowledge engine (Figma/Linear).

empty_states.description: Abstract architecture/construction structural lines for empty states or backgrounds
